parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: Reflect in the $y$-axis, translate by vector $\begin{pmatrix}-1\\0\end{pmatrix}$, and stretch by factor $2$ parallel to the $y$-axis, in a correct order.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Reflection in the $y$-axis — B1; B1 for reflection and B1 for mention of the $y$-axis, OE. SC B2 for stretch, scale factor $-1$, parallel to the $x$-axis.
Translation by $\begin{pmatrix}-1\\0\end{pmatrix}$ — B1*; B1 for ‘translation’ and correct vector/description. Do not accept ‘left’/‘right’. If two translations, then B0 and B0 for the order.
Stretch, factor $2$, parallel to the $y$-axis — B2,1,0; B2 all correct OE, B1 any two parts correct; may occur at any point in the sequence.
Correct order and three correctly named transformations only — DB1; if a fourth transformation is given, this mark is not awarded and no marks are given for the two transformations of the same type, except where the reflection is described as a stretch. If any transformation is incorrectly named, this cannot be given. If translation is not $\begin{pmatrix}-1\\0\end{pmatrix}$ or $\begin{pmatrix}1\\0\end{pmatrix}$, DB0.
Alternative first three marks: translation $\begin{pmatrix}1\\0\end{pmatrix}$ — B1* for translation and correct vector/description; reflection in the $y$-axis — B1 B1 for reflection and axis.
Other alternatives can be marked similarly; e.g. the given stretch, translation $\begin{pmatrix}-4\\0\end{pmatrix}$, reflection in $x=-2.5$.
Total: 6
